swayable.summary: A mayor of Panama City who survived a Colombian prison warns that the Panama Canal is under threat from Chinese control and that losing U.S. leadership would doom the world. He speaks directly to camera in a personal, urgent tone mixing his own story with geopolitical argument.
swayable.title: Panama's Jailed Mayor Warns: The Canal Is Not Just a Canal
